description: This file implements a speech processing pipeline for a conversational AI system, including audio collection, transcription, context management, and interaction with language models and TTS services.

classes.name: UserAudioCollector
classes.description: Collects audio frames during user speech and adds them to the context when user stops speaking.

classes.name: InputTranscriptionContextFilter
classes.description: Filters frames to only process relevant LLMContextFrame for transcription.

classes.name: LLMDemoTranscriptionFrame
classes.description: Custom frame to hold transcription output, avoiding misinterpretation as speech by TTS.

classes.name: InputTranscriptionFrameEmitter
classes.description: Aggregates text frames from the transcriber LLM and emits a combined transcription frame.

classes.name: TranscriptionContextFixup
classes.description: Replaces user message audio content with text transcription to reduce bandwidth and latency.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes individual frames for various purposes such as collection, filtering, and transcription handling.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the speech processing pipeline with specified transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializing transport and starting the pipeline.
